body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-02-06 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "I don't expect much revenues in FY '26, but FY '27 onwards, we can expect significant revenue." Metric: Substation EPC orders / revenue / margin. Target: first major order (~INR 60-70 cr) near term; 'significant' revenue FY27+; >= industry margin (13-15%). Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: vague; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: First substation EPC order was INR ~45 cr (66 kV), vs 'INR 60-70 cr' expected. Nov-25: two small/medium projects (132/220 kV) to commission in FY27. Apr-26: 'executing close to about 4 high-voltage substations'. No substation revenue disclosed yet.
